report.headline: Dispatch five-minute TOTALDEMAND highest in the returned 5-minute fields at 2026-07-29 19:35 AEST (2026-07-29T09:35:00Z): 10,890.3 MW.
summary: Highest observed dispatch five-minute TOTALDEMAND in the returned 5-minute fields: 10,890.3 MW at interval ending 2026-07-29 19:35 AEST (2026-07-29T09:35:00Z).
TOTALDEMAND at the price-peak interval (interval ending 2026-07-29 20:05 AEST / 2026-07-29T10:05:00Z) was 10,761.01 MW.
Half-hour operational demand (a different measure) had a maximum of 11,079.0 MW at interval ending 2026-07-29 19:00 AEST (2026-07-29T09:00:00Z).
AEMO published a market notice for NSW1 that declared unit WTAHB1 non-conforming on 29 July 2026 (see published_findings).

possible_explanations.statement: The AEMO non-conformance notice for unit WTAHB1 [c1] might be relevant to system conditions on 29 July 2026.
